description: Korean market data for agents: tradeable-basis kimchi premium, history/percentiles, translated news.
name: io.github.juh5ng/k-data-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated wallet holding USDC on Base. Each tool call spends from it. No ETH needed - x402 settles off-chain and the facilitator pays gas.
environmentVariables.name: K_DATA_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Hard cap on cumulative spend for the session. The server refuses any call that would exceed it.
environmentVariables.name: K_DATA_MAX_SPEND_USD

environmentVariables.description: Point at a different K-Data deployment.
environmentVariables.name: K_DATA_BASE_URL
